🚨 Tata Capital | CA Industrial Trainee – Internal Audit

📍 Location: Thane West, Mumbai Metropolitan Region
💰 Stipend: Competitive (as per industry standards)

✅ Preferred Candidate Profile

• Cleared both groups of CA Intermediate in the first attempt
• Strong analytical and auditing aptitude
• Mumbai/Thane residents preferred
• Passionate about learning and building a career in Internal Audit

🌟 What You'll Gain

• Exposure to diverse Internal Audit assignments
• Practical understanding of Risk Management & Internal Controls
• Opportunity to work alongside experienced finance and audit professionals
• Valuable industry experience with a trusted Tata Group company

📩 How to Apply?
Comment your email ID or send me a DM, and I'll share the application details.

👍 Don't forget to Like, Comment & Repost so this opportunity reaches deserving CA students.
